scope: Private lower host primitive only, analogous to host-publish steps. No authority barrel export, public action, role/approval grant, opaque host factory, generic DB capability or real B1 phase is added by this component.

seed.copy: Every seed call returns independent bytes; no file or database is created by reading the packaged seed.

api.readReconciliationAdmissionAnchor: (root: string) => ReconciliationAdmissionAnchor; reads and validates an already existing exact private anchor only, never opens SQLite
api.withReconciliationAdmissionSteps: <T>(root: string, expected: ReconciliationAdmissionAnchor, callback: () => T) => T; trusted synchronous internal callback only, never caller CLI data
api.ReconciliationAdmissionError: Error with readonly code and optional readonly stage=rollback|close; native exception text/cause, SQL, file contents and callback values never become error diagnostics

anchor.root: Absolute canonical realpath of already existing owned0700 private directory. Trusted final host resolves this; no public command accepts a physical anchor path.
anchor.identity_encoding: All IDs/times are lossless canonical unsigned decimal strings; root mode is0700, seed mode0600, size_bytes is number8192. Filesystem owner equals actual effective UID. Seed is regular and single-linked. Directory mtime is deliberately excluded: admitted child publication may change it.
anchor.data: Deep-frozen public metadata only, no private key. Expected witness must have exact own enumerable data fields/plain or null prototypes; getter/Proxy/unknown fields refuse. It is a state witness, not authority.

physical_paths.namespace: Other legitimate issuer/approval files may exist; this primitive neither reads nor rewrites them. Any existing forbidden sidecar, even empty or symlink, refuses; no hot-journal recovery permission.

read_protocol: Support darwin/linux effective-UID private namespace. Reject unsupported platform or missing effective UID before writable access.

Resolve and lstat root and seed, reject symlinks/noncanonical path/type/mode/owner/link count/size. Check process-local live anchor map by device+inode before any raw open or close, including aliases.

Use an O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW descriptor for seed; verify descriptor identities against lstat, read exactly8192 bounded bytes, verify fixed SHA256, recheck descriptor/path metadata and sidecar absence. Close raw descriptor before any SQLite connection opens. No repair, file creation, SQL or directory creation.
lock_protocol: Reject Proxy, async/generator or nonfunction callback before writable native access. Validate expected closed witness and freshly read actual anchor. Drift refuses before callback.

Reserve device+inode in module-private process-local map. Any nested/reentrant inspection or admission, including an alias, refuses before a raw descriptor or second SQLite connection can open/close. Keep reservation through SQLite close.

Open only the internally generated pathToFileURL(anchor)+?mode=rw URI with timeout0 and extension loading disabled. Never use rwc, immutable, nolock, caller URI/SQL, alternate VFS or a plain-path CREATE fallback. Missing file must remain absent. Runtime without this URI behavior refuses; final installed host qualification is still required.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE supplies kernel exclusion. SQLITE_BUSY/LOCKED is a bounded refusal, no retry/takeover. Validate fixed schema/row through constant read-only SQL and lstat metadata/sidecar checks only while connection lives. Never raw-read/open/close the DB or open another connection in this interval.

Run exactly one trusted synchronous callback, preserving its result or ordinary exception after cleanup. Reject Promise/thenable/Proxy result without invoking then/getters. Native async/generator callbacks are never invoked. This does not undo callback effects or prove arbitrary user JavaScript synchronous; production callbacks are fixed trusted host code, not caller functions.

Revalidate closed SQL schema/row and unchanged lstat metadata after normal callback completion. ROLLBACK and close always run; no SQL writes, PRAGMA mutations, journal recovery, fsync/rename/unlink, namespace cleanup or seed publication.

If rollback or close fails, return RELEASE_INDETERMINATE with only stage/code, retain module-private live reservation and connection custody, and refuse further same-process admission/inspection. Do not claim release, retry, completion or erase domain files. Process exit releases the OS lock; actual Owner lease recovery remains a separately authorized operation.

closed_sql.schema: SELECT type,name,tbl_name,rootpage,sql FROM sqlite_schema ORDER BY name

expected_schema_row.name: admission_protocol
expected_schema_row.sql: CREATE TABLE admission_protocol(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1))

closed_sql.rows: SELECT singleton,version FROM admission_protocol ORDER BY singleton

independent_tests: Authentic absent-module RED; fixed seed bytes/hash/copy isolation and readonly inspection zero SQLite/file effects.

Actual already-existing private fixture, wrong seed/schema/size/mode/type/owner/symlink/hardlink/sidecar and stale witness refusal before callback or writable SQL. Expected getter/Proxy/malformed metadata never executes.

Actual native two-process contention and fixture-owned holder SIGKILL: successor enters without reaping a filesystem mutex; seed bytes/inode remain unchanged and no sidecars appear. External counter serializes under actual compiled primitive, not a hand-written stand-in.
Nested/alias inspection cannot open/close a DB descriptor and accidentally release a POSIX lock; foreign process remains refused until owner actually exits.
Actual URI rw behavior, encoded question/hash path handling, no CREATE fallback, closed SQL whitelist and mode/identity recheck. Do not set immutable=1: it disables SQLite locking.

Async/generator/thenable/Proxy callbacks/results reject, ordinary callback error releases lock, rollback/close faults retain exact indeterminate custody in disposable child processes; no raw native message/cause leakage.
fixture_execution: Tests may transpile the exact two source modules with existing TypeScript into an external ESM fixture directory for real Node24 child execution, sealing source/output hashes. No new dependency or fake SQLite engine. This qualifies the lower component, not an installed public CLI.
trust_boundary: Protects untrusted data and governed runtime participants on the same admitted local host. It does not claim isolation against arbitrary same-UID external filesystem replacement, compromised runtime/native VFS or OS administrator. Final adapter must bind trusted private namespace, actual host/worktree, package and policy, and qualify actual filesystem locking before any product use.
